title: Commercial AI and retinal specialists compared for retinal fluid detection on OCT in AMD
summary: On 1127 eyes of 651 AREDS2-10Y participants with reading-center grading as ground truth, the AI had accuracy 0.851 and sensitivity 0.822 for any fluid versus 0.805 and 0.468 for the study investigators. The AI was weaker for subretinal fluid accuracy (0.863 versus 0.946). The algorithm pre-existed the study; this is an evaluation, not a new model.
